design_choices: Links table: one item per code (pk code#<code>) with the SHA-256 of the polling handle (GSI handle) and TTL expiresAt; sessions are separate items (pk session#<sha256>) without TTL, read strongly consistent.
The session token is minted on the first poll after confirmation (TV path), so the raw token is never stored; later polls report linked without a token.
Unknown, used and expired codes all return 410 on confirm; a wrong passphrase returns 401 and leaves the code pending.
PUT /v1/profile implements optimistic revision checks (409) and validates Settings keys from AFC-Data.sysml; GET returns revision 0 defaults (scoringPreset halfPpr) before the first write.
Ingest schedule State defaults to DISABLED (parameter IngestScheduleState); B02 or the owner enables it for game windows.
Lambda architecture x86_64 so sam build bundles the matching rpds-py wheel; src/requirements.txt points SAM at backend/requirements.txt.

observations.observation: mutmut copies only src/, tests/, setup.cfg, pyproject.toml and lockfiles into mutants/; the frozen conftest reads backend/template.yaml, so every clean run fails with KeyError: 'DEVICE_CODE_TTL_SECONDS'. The wrapper writes setup.cfg itself and refuses [tool.mutmut], so only the wrapper can add also_copy=template.yaml.

The dedicated mutmut venv has no boto3/moto, so backend tests cannot import; running mutmut's package under the backend-tests interpreter via PYTHONPATH works without installing anything (pytest 9.1.1 from the mutmut venv).

Mutated functions are rewritten into trampolines, so AST contract tests that inspect a function body fail in mutants/. Functions with no mutants stay verbatim; '# pragma: no mutate block' on the def line keeps a function verbatim. The evaluator also needs every changed file to own at least one mutant and rejects changed module-level statements, which shaped the stub layout (a private _pending() per stub module).
A changed file with no executable lines (docstring-only __init__.py) is absent from diff-cover src_stats and is reported REPORT_INCOMPLETE instead of excluded with evidence.

samconfig.toml [default.global.parameters] profile=afc-dev makes sam build fail ('The config profile (afc-dev) could not be found') on a machine without that profile; the profile now sits only in [default.deploy.parameters]. sam validate --lint and sam build ran offline with credential files set to /dev/null.
SAM reads requirements.txt from CodeUri (src/); a one-line src/requirements.txt '-r ../requirements.txt' keeps the pinned set at backend/requirements.txt and sam build honours its --hash pins.
